info.title: Matomo Reporting API for Live plugin

get.description: Returns simple live counters for visits over the last N minutes.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: Website ID or IDs to query.

parameters.name: lastMinutes
parameters.description: Number of minutes to look back at, between 1 and 2880.

parameters.name: segment
parameters.description: Custom segment to filter the counters. Example: "referrerName==example.com" Supports AND (;) and OR (,) operators.

parameters.name: showColumns
parameters.description: Optional columns to include, for example `visits` or `actions`.

parameters.name: hideColumns
parameters.description: Optional columns to omit from the response.

200.description:
A single-row array containing the requested counters.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

get.description: Returns whether the visitor profile is enabled for the given site selection.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: Website ID or site selection to query.

200.description:
Whether visitor profiles are enabled.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

get.description: Returns the most recent visit details for one or more websites.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: Website ID(s) to query. - Single site ID (e.g. 1) - Multiple site IDs (e.g. [1, 4, 5]) - Comma-separated list ("1,4,5") or "all"

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Optional period restriction.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Optional date or date range restriction.

parameters.name: segment
parameters.description: Custom segment to filter the visits. Example: "referrerName==example.com" Supports AND (;) and OR (,) operators.

parameters.name: countVisitorsToFetch
parameters.description: Deprecated explicit row limit. Prefer `filter_offset` and `filter_limit`.

parameters.name: minTimestamp
parameters.description: Optional minimum timestamp for incremental refreshes or pagination.

parameters.name: flat
parameters.description: Whether to flatten action details into the visit rows.

parameters.name: doNotFetchActions
parameters.description: Whether to skip fetching action details for better performance.

parameters.name: enhanced
parameters.description: Whether plugins should enrich the returned visit details.

200.description:
Recent visit details.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

get.description: Returns a visitor profile built from the visitor's recent visits.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the website to query.

parameters.name: visitorId
parameters.description: Optional visitor ID. If omitted, the most recent visitor is used.

parameters.name: segment
parameters.description: Custom segment to filter the profile lookup. Example: "referrerName==example.com" Supports AND (;) and OR (,) operators.

parameters.name: limitVisits
parameters.description: Optional maximum number of visits to include in the profile.

200.description:
Visitor profile data, or an empty array if no visitor is found.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

get.description: Returns the visitor ID of the most recent visit.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the website to query.

parameters.name: segment
parameters.description: Custom segment to filter the lookup. Example: "referrerName==example.com" Supports AND (;) and OR (,) operators.

200.description:
Visitor ID of the most recent matching visit, or `false` if none is found.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

get.description: Returns the most recent UTC datetime when an action was performed for the given website or websites.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: Website ID or IDs to query.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Optional period restriction.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Optional date or date range restriction.

200.description:
Most recent visit datetime in UTC, or an empty string if none exists.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

tags.name: Live
tags.description: The Live! API lets you access complete visit level information about your visitors. Combined with the power of Segmentation, you will be able to request visits filtered by any criteria. The method "getLastVisitsDetails" will return extensive RAW data for each visit, which includes: server time, visitId, visitorId, visitorType (new or returning), number of pages, list of all pages (and events, file downloaded and outlinks clicked), custom variables names and values set to this visit, number of goal conversions (and list of all Goal conversions for this visit, with time of conversion, revenue, URL, etc.), but also other attributes such as: days since last visit, days since first visit, country, continent, visitor IP, provider, referrer used (referrer name, keyword if it was a search engine, full URL), campaign name and keyword, operating system, browser, type of screen, resolution, supported browser plugins (flash, java, silverlight, pdf, etc.), various dates & times format to make it easier for API users... and more! With the parameter '&segment=' you can filter the returned visits by any criteria (visitor IP, visitor ID, country, keyword used, time of day, etc.). The method "getCounters" is used to return a simple counter: visits, number of actions, number of converted visits, in the last N minutes. See also the documentation about Real time widget and visitor level reports in Matomo. You may also be interested in steps to export your RAW data to a data warehouse.
